name: Pegboard on floor-to-ceiling posts (no drilling)
description: White pre-finished hardboard pegboard (6 mm, holes 6 mm on a 25 mm grid) screwed to two 2x4 posts laid flat, wedged between floor and ceiling with 2x4 post adjusters (e.g. LABRICO) — nothing is fixed to the wall. ~4.4 cm deep without tools, ~15 cm with hooks and tools. Origin: back-centre on the floor.

source.notes: 2x4 = 3.8 x 8.9 cm. Pegboard sheets are sold 122 x 244 and cut to size. Tools are demo shapes.

postInset.description: cm from the board edge to the post
